answer_text: Slow internet can be caused by sub-optimal routing or poor Wi‑Fi signal. To diagnose, run a ping test and a traceroute to compare latency when traffic passes through Cato versus bypassing Cato. If you’re on Wi‑Fi and the signal is weak (for example around -75 dBm or lower), that can also cause slow performance; improving the wireless signal or using a wired connection may help.
